title: Mock Up Your Redesign
bottom_line: Run `/design-inspiration:mockup` on your rated shortlist to see your own pages in the look you loved, then comment to have it revised.

sections.heading: Run it on a shortlist to create, on a mockup to revise

blocks.caption: The command. Both parts in brackets are optional.

blocks.title: What the link you give decides

nodes.label: You run mockup with a link

blocks.caption: Any other page: it says it needs a shortlist or a mockup made by this plugin.

blocks.title: Arguments
rows: The newest "<app> Design Mockup" or "<app> Design Shortlist" artifact for this repo (asks when several match; stops with a pointer to `/design-inspiration:find` when none does)
A shortlist to build from, or a mockup to revise
Model of the subagent that builds the mockup

blocks.title: When to use it
blocks.text: Use it when you have rated a shortlist and want to see the result first: "show me what it would look like", "mock it up", "preview the redesign", "I left comments on the mockup", or when you pass a shortlist or mockup Artifact link, even if you do not say "mockup".

sections.heading: It is an optional step between find and plan

blocks.text: This step is optional. It shows you what you will get before anything is planned. `/design-inspiration:plan <mockup url>` later plans to build what the mockup shows.

sections.heading: You need a shortlist with at least one Love

cards.title: A rated shortlist
cards.text: A shortlist from `/design-inspiration:find` with at least one design rated Love.

cards.title: Your app's repo
cards.text: Run it from the root of the app's repo, because it reads that repo's templates and styles.

cards.title: playwright-cli
cards.text: The Playwright CLI, for checking the pages.

cards.title: python3
cards.text: For the mockup check's local server.

cards.title: plan-tools
cards.text: The design-inspiration plugin depends on plan-tools, which is installed with it.

sections.heading: On a shortlist it asks once, builds, checks and publishes

steps.title: Reads your ratings and notes
steps.text: It reads them the same way `plan` does. App pages with no Love card are left out and named. If no card is rated Love anywhere, it stops and tells you to rate at least one design Love first.

steps.title: Asks once
steps.text: It asks the model (Opus, the default, or Sonnet, cheaper and faster), and per app page "Shallow redesign", "Deep redesign" or "Full redesign". A note that plainly ends mid-sentence is not guessed at: it asks you for the full note.

steps.title: Builds each app page
steps.text: A subagent builds each app page in the look of your Love designs, with made-up sample data. A Maybe card contributes only what its note asks for, and each note is a requirement.

steps.title: Answer any design questions
steps.text: If the designs, notes and brief do not settle a design decision, it collects those questions and you are asked them together, once.

steps.title: Checks three widths
steps.text: The skill checks every page at desktop, tablet and phone width.

steps.title: Publishes the mockup
steps.text: It publishes one Artifact titled "<app> Design Mockup": a tab per app page and a Desktop / Tablet / Phone switch.

blocks.title: What it never does
items: It never reuses the source designs' images, logos or copy: it recreates the style in its own HTML and CSS.
It edits no file in your repo.

sections.heading: Pick how much of each page may change

cards.title: Shallow redesign
cards.text: Keeps the page's structure and changes the look. Use it when the page works and mainly needs to look better.

cards.title: Deep redesign
cards.text: Keeps every feature and all the data, and may present them differently. Use it when the content is right but should be shown differently.

cards.title: Full redesign
cards.text: Anything may change. Use it when the page itself should change.

blocks.caption: You pick one mode per app page.

blocks.title: The three modes in full
rows: The real page's structure: a table stays a table, a list stays a list, and every section, field and control stays. Adds nothing and removes nothing.
The look, the spacing, the order and what the headers do
The page works and mainly needs to look better
Every feature and all the data the page shows. Removes nothing.
How they are presented: reordering, a table turned into cards or a graph of the same data, new elements
The page has the right content but should present it differently

sections.heading: The responsive mockup shows every page at three sizes

items.label: Smallest control size
items.note: high and wide, at phone and tablet widths

blocks.title: What each mockup page holds
items: A tab per app page, and a Desktop / Tablet / Phone switch to see each app page at each size.
Per page, "Deliberate changes": every change the mockup makes on purpose beyond the look.
Per page, "Differences from the real page": what the mockup cannot show faithfully.
Every button, link and other control stays at least 44px high and wide at phone and tablet widths. A request for "less space" is met with layout, never by going under that size.

sections.heading: Comment on the mockup, then run it again on the mockup link

steps.title: Comment in claude.ai
steps.text: Comment on the mockup in claude.ai, on any tab.

steps.title: Send each thread to Claude
steps.text: Reply with "Send to Claude" or mention @claude.

steps.title: Run mockup on the mockup link
steps.text: Run the command with the mockup's link.

steps.title: It changes only what you asked
steps.text: It ties each comment to its app page (and asks you when it cannot tell), changes only what you asked, republishes at the same link, and replies to and resolves each thread.

blocks.title: Good to know
items: Threads you did not send to Claude are still acted on, but stay open and are listed for you.
A comment whose request is unclear is not guessed at: it gets one question back and stays open.
If there are no open comments, it tells you there is nothing to revise.

sections.heading: A failed Claude reply under a comment loses nothing

cards.title: "Claude tried to reply"
cards.text: When no session is watching the mockup, claude.ai shows this message under a comment sent to Claude.

points.text: Running mockup on the mockup link picks up every open comment.

cards.title: No Love card
cards.text: If no card is rated Love anywhere, it stops.

points.text: Rate at least one design Love on the shortlist, then run it again.

cards.title: No shortlist or mockup found
cards.text: With no link and no matching artifact for this repo, it stops.

blocks.title: The exact message
blocks.text: "Claude tried to reply but couldn't. To retry, reply to the comment and send the reply to Claude." Running `/design-inspiration:mockup <mockup url>` picks up every open comment.

sections.heading: When you are happy, plan from the mockup

before.label: Mockup
before.text: A preview of your pages in the chosen look, revised from your comments.

after.label: Plan
after.text: `/design-inspiration:plan <mockup url>` plans to build what the mockup shows.

next_action.text: From your app's repo root, run `/design-inspiration:mockup` with your rated shortlist's link.
